title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt regression metrics into CI gates and add quality gating hook
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: we need per-prompt regression visibility in CI so model/serving changes cannot silently degrade specific prompt sets that power customer flows. This PR wires per-prompt metrics (accuracy, hallucination_rate proxy, token-level latency) into the eval-harness CI hook and introduces a configurable quality gating step that can fail CI when a prompt-set's metric regresses beyond configured thresholds. What changed: 1) new exporter: eval-harness/metrics/per_prompt_exporter.py that emits per-prompt aggregates and metadata; 2) CI hook: .github/hooks/eval_prompt_metrics_hook.py that runs after unit/integration tests and posts a summary to CI with an exit code for gating; 3) thresholds config: eval-harness/config/prompt_quality_thresholds.yaml with sane defaults and per-team overrides; 4) dashboarding: lightweight CSV/json summary writer for ingestion into our metrics pipeline; 5) tests and fixtures: tests/eval_harness/test_per_prompt_metrics.py and prompt fixtures for 3 representative prompt-sets; 6) docs: docs/eval-harness/ci-metrics-integration.md describing how to opt-in and tune thresholds. Checklist: - [x] add exporter and hook - [x] unit tests for exporter and gating logic - [x] end-to-end CI simulation in workflow - [x] docs and runbook updates - [x] rollout plan (opt-in by default on staging, opt-out on release branches). Backwards compatibility: the hook is behind a feature flag (EVAL_PER_PROMPT_METRICS) and defaults to off for release branches to avoid noisy failures during rollout. Rollout plan: enable on staging for two weeks, iterate thresholds with SRE and product owners, then flip on for main with a low severity gating mode (warn-only) before enforcing fail-on-regression.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice end-to-end. Question: can thresholds be overridden per-repo or per-team? Reply: yes, the YAML supports repo/team keys; default fallback is global.
Riley Chen: The gating exit codes need to be more granular so infra can choose warn vs fail. Reply: changed hook to support --mode=warn|fail, and workflow uses warn by default on main until enforced.

Sara Morales: Can we ensure this doesn't slow CI significantly? Reply: exporter runs on sampled prompts (configurable) and the hook runs after tests in a separate job; added sampling config and benchmarked to ~8s added latency on staging.
Reviewer: Found a flake with empty prompt lists in the exporter. Author: fixed in last commit and added unit test to cover empty prompt-set edge case.
Approver: +1 from product and SRE after seeing staging run results.

release_notes: Add per-prompt evaluation metrics integration into CI: teams can opt-in to fail or warn when specific prompt-sets regress against configured thresholds. This enables targeted quality gating and faster detection of model/serving regressions.
notes: Deployed behind feature flag EVAL_PER_PROMPT_METRICS. Staged on staging for 2024-11-08..2024-11-22. SRE to monitor noise and adjust sampling/thresholds.
